CustomField.description: System this mapping belongs to. A local picklist rather than the External_System global value set, because custom metadata types do not support global value sets - the deploy says "Global picklists are not supported on this object". The values must therefore be kept in step with the global set by hand; ExternalSystem.cls is the one place the vocabulary is written down, and FieldMappingServiceTest asserts the two agree.
CustomField.label: External System
